shortDescription: Update automated renewal configurations of certificate through SCEP.

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: scep_days_before_expire
options.description: Days to renew the certificate before expiration. Valid range is 14 - 60.

options.name: scep_on
options.description: Enable or disable the automated renewal

options.name: scep_renewal_interval_in_minutes
options.description: Certificate validation frequency in minutes. Valid range is 60 - 1440.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for getting automated renewal configurations, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
